The engineer course is organized as eight complete, clean-kernel Chapters.
Chapter 1 is implemented now. Chapters 2–8 are the migration roadmap, not fake
runnable pages. The former sixteen-Chapter course remains available under one
**Migration legacy** heading while its reviewed content moves into this order.

::: {.callout-warning title="Course candidate · CONVERGING" appearance="simple"}
The public authoring grammar, Parameter System, and certified diagram scopes
remain `CONVERGING`; accepted numerical Results keep their existing meanings.
Generated figures are source-bound evidence for exact checkpoints, not proof
of course acceptance, release, or every historical cell. The website executes
no kernels or solvers.
:::

## Chapter 1 — Coupled grounded LC

Build a 110 fF / 5.8 nH grounded resonator, connect it through a 6 fF coupler to
a terminated 50 ohm Port, inspect its authoring diagram, read one-port S11 and
the loaded root, then select 120 fF on the same Plan.

## Eight-Chapter roadmap

| Chapter | Outcome | Availability |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Coupled grounded LC | Build, diagram, S11, loaded root, selected C | Current five-Lesson Chapter |
| 2. Sweep and Optimization | Inputs, bindings, points, spaces, and established Optimization workflow | Future |
| 3. CPW feedline/readout S21 | Ordered two-section CPW, coupled readout, two-Port response | Future; bounded Default diagram currently reports a fixed-layout collision |
| 4. Four-Port capstone | Original physical Plan and PTC core, then optional transform, quantities, and pump-off HB | Future; existing explicit capstone diagram is viable |
| 5. Library | Create, publish, instantiate, and reuse a Composite | Future |
| 6. Diagram customization | Default completion, bounded hints, composition, and A/B review | Future |
| 7. MTL | Ordered multi-conductor RLGC and finite-pi compiled evidence | Future |
| 8. Report and resolve | Exact requests, Results, workspaces, reports, and restart-safe resolution | Future |

The [durable migration map](implementation/engineer-course-migration-map.qmd)
records how each former Chapter moves and which Concept, Contract, or
implementation page remains authoritative.

## Migration legacy

The sixteen prior QMD/IPYNB pairs and their source-bound figures remain intact
under [`examples/tutorials/`](../examples/tutorials/01_author_primitive.qmd).
They are readable migration inputs, not a second current syllabus. Their
historical fixtures remain implementation-baseline evidence and are not
imported by Chapter 1.

For rationale, read [Concept](concepts/physical-authority-and-reusable-composition.qmd).
For exact signatures, equations, invariants, identities, and failure behavior,
use the [Contract map](contracts/index.qmd).
